consequence.statement: Config Management Plugins now receive empty environment variables in addition to set ones, changing the environment context visible to plugins.

original.statement: Config Management Plugins now receive empty environment variables that were previously not passed.

decision.reason: [ev-dd28456702c2] says only that Argo CD 3.0.0 now passes empty env vars to plugins (CMP). That changes what plugins receive at runtime. Nothing in it says anything fails, is rejected or must be migrated, so a failure kind would over-claim. behavior-change, which means review, is the least that follows from the text. The severity and the exact effect on plugin logic are inferred and not stated, so confidence is low.
